about:
Precision Resistive Products (PRP) operates from Mediapolis, Iowa, where it has served the electronics industry for over 47 years. The company's founding year and original owners are not publicly disclosed, but its longevity points to a stable, privately held operation.

PRP manufactures a broad line of precision resistors in both leaded and surface-mount formats. Its portfolio spans thin-film, wire-wound, thick-film, metal-film, power, metal-strip, shunt, current-sense, surge, pulse-withstanding, and metal-oxide technologies. Recent additions include the GMR Series of aluminum-housed power wire-wound resistors (5–300 W) and the AEC-Q200-qualified PTNF Series tantalum-nitride thin-film chip resistors, alongside the PR9544 ultra-precise thin-film network chip, the PR9372 leaded metal-film audio resistor, and the GP Series general-purpose metal-film parts.

The company explicitly targets automotive applications with its AEC-Q200-compliant PTNF Series, indicating a focus on the automotive electronics supply chain. Beyond automotive, its standard and non-standard resistor values serve a range of OEMs and design engineers across industrial, instrumentation, and consumer electronics markets, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

PRP emphasizes “Dedicated to Excellence” as its guiding principle, highlighting high quality, competitive pricing, and quick delivery as differentiators for its newer product lines. The firm also maintains compliance documentation and cross-reference tools to support customer procurement.
